profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full Stack Software Engineer specializing in Typescript, Java, and Python utilizing technologies including React, AngularJS, Node.js, Postgres, and Spring.

Experience building full stack applications in a wide variety of fields including trading, media management, and marketing.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
-Purified and characterized amyloid proteins including alpha synuclein, ubiquitin, and Efhd2  involved in protein aggregation and fibril formation associated with Alzheimer's Disease, Multiple Sclerosis, Parkinson's Disease and other neurodegenerative diseases.
- Performed data analysis on fibril formation assay results from multiple amyloid proteins under varying conditions including pH levels, protein concentrations, and inhibitor concentrations.
- Captured TEM images of micro fibril formations of various amyloid proteins.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Aided in the development of a procedure for a cell free zebrafish droplet extract system in order to investigate the synchronization of mitotic cell division seen in embryos.
- Captured still and time lapse images with fluorescence microscopy using xenopus extracts and zebrafish embryos along with DAPI and NLS-GFP fluorescent proteins.
- Performed maintenance on zebrafish facilities including maintaining pH levels, salinity levels, and ensuring overall health of the zebrafish.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Performed the purification and characterization through mice models of the myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein (MOG) associated with Parkinson's disease.
- Harvested brain and spine samples from mice injected with the MOG protein.

publications.title: Surface Heterogeneity of Insulin Fibrils Revealed by Time-Resolved Spectroscopy Measurements of Fluorescent Probes
